hero.headline: Football scores and match alerts in Telegram
hero.subhead: Live Score delivers configurable match notifications in personal chats, groups, and channels — plus a Mini App to browse matches and manage favourites.

notifications.title: Match notifications where you already chat
notifications.description: Get goals, finals, and other alerts for the teams and fixtures you follow. Defaults favour goals, full-time results, and highlight; you can tune the visible prefs in the Mini App.
bullets: Personal DMs for your favourites — free, no Stars plan
Groups and channels receive chat notifications after you register the bot
Configurable prefs: goals, goal scorer, final, kickoff, half-time, second half, pre-match 15, red card, and delay
notifications.imageAlt: Live Score match notification example in Telegram

miniApp.title: Mini App for matches, favourites, and settings
miniApp.description: Open the Telegram Mini App from LiveScoreAppBot to browse the calendar, open match detail, manage favourites, and configure notification prefs.
bullets: Matches, leagues, teams, and match detail tabs (overview, statistics, lineups, H2H, table)
Favourites and settings for personal chats, groups, and channels
Official league channels list inside the app
miniApp.imageAlt: Live Score Mini App matches screen

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: Three audiences, one bot. Pick your path — steps match what LiveScoreAppBot ships today.

tabs.label: Personal
steps: Open a private chat with LiveScoreAppBot and send /start
See demo alerts, then open the Mini App to pick teams and favourites
Tune notification prefs in Mini App Settings; send /stop anytime to pause personal delivery

tabs.label: Groups
steps: In a private chat with the bot, send /group
Share a group where you and the bot have the required admin rights
Open the group Mini App links for favourites, settings, or Chat Premium when you need more than one team or league favourite

tabs.label: Channels
steps: In a private chat with the bot, send /channel
Share a channel with the required post rights so the bot can deliver alerts
Manage favourites and settings in the channel Mini App; Chat Premium unlocks more than one team or league favourite

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Personal use stays free. Groups and channels get a free favourite quota; Chat Premium is optional Stars for chats that need more.

personal.label: Personal
personal.title: Free for personal chats
personal.body: Personal profiles have no Stars plan and no chat Premium checkout. Favourites alerts stay configurable without an upgrade.
points: Unlimited personal use — no Stars required
Favourites: fixtures and teams (personal league favourites are not offered)
No Stars upgrade for personal chats

chats.label: Groups & channels
chats.title: Free tier + Chat Premium
chats.body: Registered groups and channels start free with one combined team or league favourite. Chat Premium unlocks more favourites.
points: Free: 1 team or league favourite per registered chat
Chat Premium: 49 Telegram Stars for 30 days
24-hour grace after lapse; fixture favourites are not part of that quota
Premium checkout is owner-only in the Mini App

channels.title: Official league channels
channels.description: Follow app-owner Telegram channels for leagues. This list is separate from user-registered notification channels via /channel.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Short answers grounded in what Live Score ships today.

items.question: What is Live Score?
items.answer: A Telegram football product: LiveScoreAppBot delivers match notifications, and a Mini App lets you browse matches and manage favourites.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: Personal DMs, Telegram groups, and Telegram channels. Each audience registers and receives alerts through the same bot.

items.question: Is personal use free?
items.answer: Yes. Personal chats have no Stars plan and no chat Premium. You get configurable favourites alerts without an upgrade.

items.question: How do I connect a group?
items.answer: Open a private chat with LiveScoreAppBot, send /group, then share a group where you and the bot have the required admin rights. Registration can still fail on type, rights, access, or conflicts.

items.question: How do I connect a channel?
items.answer: Same flow with /channel from a private chat, sharing a channel with the required post rights. User-registered channels are distinct from official league channels.

items.question: What is Chat Premium?
items.answer: An optional Stars subscription for registered groups and channels only: 49 Stars for 30 days with a 24-hour grace after lapse. Free chats keep one combined team or league favourite.

items.question: What can I configure in notifications?
items.answer: Visible Mini App switches cover goal, goal scorer, final, kickoff, half-time, second half, pre-match 15, red card, plus a short delay option. Defaults favour goals, finals, and highlight (the highlight switch is not shown in Settings).

items.question: What is the Mini App?
items.answer: The Telegram WebApp opened from the bot: matches calendar, match detail, favourites, settings, start/team pick, and the official league channels list.

items.question: What are official league channels?
items.answer: Public Telegram channels owned by the Live Score app owner and listed for discovery. They are not the same as notification profiles you register with /channel.

items.question: How do I stop personal alerts?
items.answer: Send /stop in Telegram (or use the unsubscribe path). You can reactivate later with /start or from the Mini App.

closingCta.heading: Start with LiveScoreAppBot
closingCta.subheading: Open the bot on Telegram for personal alerts, group and channel registration, and the Mini App.
